description: This is a Java test class for the KeyboardFactory component of the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of keyboard add-ons, including checking multiple alphabet support, default keyboard ID, and API level parsing.

classes.name: KeyboardFactoryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the KeyboardFactory functionalities in the AnySoftKeyboard project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the KeyboardFactory instance before each test.

methods.name: hasMultipleAlphabets
methods.description: Tests whether the keyboard factory correctly reports multiple alphabet support based on add-on enablement.

methods.name: testDefaultKeyboardId
methods.description: Verifies that the default keyboard add-on has the expected ID and default enabled status.

methods.name: testParsesApiLevel
methods.description: Checks that the API level of a specific add-on is correctly parsed and matches the resource value.
